1/10 attempt of trolling.
You can characterize an opinion or perspective you’d like to reject this way. If we put it into the “fight or flight” category, depending on next steps, I often see what I would classify as a “skunk defense” where someone “kicks up a stink” (makes some random claims) and then runs away (blocks the actor with an opposing viewpoint.
Bottom line: You seem to care about bots, while expecting someone else to do something about them. I’m pointing out that while your efforts of right-click reporting are likely helpful to some extent, that it is unlikely that botting (or automation in general) is going to become less pervasive as we go forward with the rate of technological advancement increasing.
And indeed, if we look historically, there are no times when we have had no bots in WoW.
I am suggesting to prioritize your mental health over what you perceive as an issue in an online video game.
Now, here’s a claim: I don’t think botting has a particularly negative impact on any given individual’s play experience, on average. That isn’t to say that nobody has every had a negative encounter with a bot.
